details: SetButtonColor poses as a library that sets a button's background color. Its only code, lib/net8.0/SetButtonColor.dll, downloads a file from a raw.githubusercontent.com URL named like an axios project file and writes it to the user's Temp directory as winservice.exe. InitializeCustomButton, from the same campaign, starts that file. Part of the fake job assessment campaign described in the referenced article.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

files.note: Downloads a file and writes it to Temp as winservice.exe.
